title: This STEM subscription is one of the best things on Amazon!!!
text:
A work colleague of mine recommended this STEM subscription for my daughter's since hers absolutely love it. I was skeptical at first but set up the monthly for my 6 year old and also for my 9 year old (different age group subscriptions).

I was blown away on the first month with the value of the selection AND how much my daughter's loved them. I was expecting the value to drop in subsequent months, but so far it has not. This month's marbulous kit was just as much as a hit with my 6 year old as the others. She has not stopped playing with it for 2 days straight.

This subscription is a great way to get your kids interested in STEM as well as a great way to incentivize and reward them. Bank them for birthdays or holidays or keep a running sticker chore chart with the STEM toy being the monthly reward for hitting the mark.

I can't recommend this subscription enough.
label: positive
